meta.title: Ashes of the Iron Spire
meta.premise: An exiled ranger returns to a sunken border watchtower where the signal beacon burns black.

protagonist.name: Kaelen
protagonist.equipment: Ashwood Longbow, Ranger Cloak (1 Armor), Signal Horn
features: Favored Enemy (Advantage on tracking & lore checks against chosen foes)
Natural Explorer (Deft Explorer expertise & wilderness navigation)

maps.briefDescription: A flooded border tower whose iron brazier burns with cold soot.

theKick.crisis: Shadow-hounds are circling the causeway as the black beacon flares.

features: Favored Enemy (Advantage on tracking & lore checks against chosen foes)
Natural Explorer (Deft Explorer expertise & wilderness navigation)
Fighting Style (Archery +2 ranged hit, Defense, Dueling, or Two-Weapon)
Spellcasting (Hunter's Mark & wilderness magic)
Colossus Slayer (+1d8 weapon damage 1/turn against wounded targets)
Primeval Awareness (Sense supernatural creatures within 1 mile; 1/1 per short rest)
Extra Attack (Attack twice whenever you take the Attack action)
Favored Enemy & Greater Explorer Improvement (+5 ft walking, climb, and swim speed)
Defensive Tactics (Multiattack Defense +4 AC vs repeat attacks & Escape the Horde)
Land's Stride (Move through nonmagical difficult terrain with no extra cost)
Conclave Mastery (Advantage on saves vs plants and terrain hazards)
Hide in Plain Sight (Nature's Veil: turn invisible as a bonus action; 2/2 per long rest)
Multiattack (Volley 10 ft AoE ranged attack or Whirlwind melee attack)
Apex Tracker (Marked quarry cannot benefit from invisibility or cover)
Vanish (Bonus Action: Hide; cannot be tracked by nonmagical means)
Superior Hunter's Defense (Reaction: Uncanny Dodge halve damage or Stand Against the Tide)
Wilderness Paragon (Critical hit range 19–20 against Favored Enemies)
Feral Senses (Pinpoint invisible creatures within 30 ft with no attack disadvantage)
Foe Slayer (Add WIS modifier to attack or damage roll 1/turn)
